messages:
Olivia (Partnerships): Heads-up — KeyForge legal sent a redline for the marketplace listing. They want explicit language around KMS/HSM attestation and no-exfil guarantees.
Ethan (Security): Can you paste the redline? I'm especially interested in the HSM attestation clause and key lifecycle requirements.
Olivia (Partnerships): pasted excerpt from the PDF: "Service must provide FIPS-validated HSM attestations, per-customer key isolation, and logging accessible to the partner for audit." They want that in the contract + marketplace listing.
Marcus (KeyForge SI): @Olivia we can provide HSM attestation reports but legal needs to confirm what level (device cert vs. per-deployment). We typically do device certs + KMS audit logs.
Priya (Legal): Quick note — marketplace agreements can't require we'd expose partner audit logs directly. We can offer a joint-attestation process and an audit support SLA. Need exact wording suggestions.
Ethan (Security): +1. Proposed wording: "Redwood will provide HSM attestation reports and KMS audit logs as part of a joint compliance review; cryptographic key material is never exported from approved HSMs." Thoughts?
Olivia (Partnerships): That sounds good. Marcus — will KeyForge accept joint attestation instead of direct log access?
Marcus (KeyForge SI): Yes, joint attestation + one-time forensic export under NDA is acceptable. We should list allowed export triggers in the SOW.
Priya (Legal): I'll draft a short clause. Also flagging SCIM/SSO: they asked for SCIM provisioning and SAML metadata in marketplace listing. Make sure we don't promise provisioning outside supported SCIM scopes.
Olivia (Partnerships): Noted — we'll phrase as "supports SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning and SAML 2.0 SSO integrations" and link to our docs. Marcus, do you have sample metadata we can include?
Marcus (KeyForge SI): I'll attach sample SAML metadata in the partner portal. For SCIM we support standard attributes only (no custom attrs) — call that out.
jenkins-bot: Deploy notification: partnership-docs branch updated with marketplace-blurb-2026-03.
Ethan (Security): Action items: 1) Priya to draft clause (ETA EOD tomorrow). 2) Marcus to upload SAML/SCIM samples. 3) Olivia to update marketplace blurb and share with KeyForge.
Olivia (Partnerships): Thanks — setting a follow-up on my calendar for Thursday. If legal needs more, ping me here. :thumbsup:
